WITH state_filter AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT state_values.s_state
    FROM (
        VALUES
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN'),
            ('TN')
    ) AS state_values(s_state)
    GROUP BY state_values.s_state
),
aggregated_result AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        s.s_state,
        grouping(s.s_state) AS g_state,
        avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
        avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
        avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
        avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
     AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
     AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
     AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
    JOIN date_dim AS d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 1999
    JOIN store AS s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN state_filter AS sf
      ON s.s_state = sf.s_state
    JOIN item AS i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, s.s_state)
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    s_state,
    g_state,
    agg1,
    agg2,
    agg3,
    agg4
FROM aggregated_result
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
